historical_sample.label: L10
historical_sample.definition: 10 most recent qualifying completed regular-season games

historical_cutoff.rule: Completion of final scheduled game of Week 7

records.context_summary: Strongest contextual profile among the candidates: stable usage, recent production above the Core threshold, and a generally favorable TE matchup. Preserve normal target/short-week variance.
records.model_judgment: Selected: 7/10 HR, threshold below 25P, stable role.

records.context_summary: The passing-yard Core has a plausible volume path but major pass-protection and pressure concerns. Context does not support treating the historical 6/10 as a forecast.
records.model_judgment: Not selected: pressure and protection concerns.

records.context_summary: Primary Carolina receiving option by target share, but quarterback pressure limits confidence. Core is more defensible than Ceiling; contextual read remains mixed.
records.model_judgment: Selected cautiously: lead target share and 6/10 HR, but QB/protection concerns.

records.context_summary: Availability is reassuring, but recent production and declining usage are warning signs. The Core reception threshold is not contextually strong enough to upgrade.
records.model_judgment: Not selected: recent usage decline and pass protection concerns.

records.context_summary: Stable role and recent four-catch game support the 3.5 Core. Context is favorable, while final receiver availability and target competition remain watch items.
records.model_judgment: Not selected: redundant exposure to Kraft receiving yards.

records.context_summary: Recent passing volume and production support the Core, but receiver availability, a short week, and the possibility of a deliberate run-game approach keep the overall context mixed.
records.model_judgment: Selected conditionally: 7/10 HR and strong recent volume; availability/game plan uncertainty.

records.context_summary: Role, Week 7 production and Carolina's depleted cornerback group support the Core receiving-yard threshold, with the main uncertainty being short-week availability and volatile big-play dependence.
records.model_judgment: Selected: 6/10 HR, threshold near 25P, recent targets and favorable secondary context.

records.context_summary: The 3.5 Core has a clear role-based path from recent target and catch volume. The context is favorable, subject to final availability and target-distribution uncertainty.
records.model_judgment: Not selected: redundant exposure to Watson receiving yards.

records.context_summary: The low Core threshold and locked historical HR are supportive, but the modest target share, volatile Week 7 output, difficult TE matchup and Carolina pass-protection concerns make the contextual read mixed.
records.model_judgment: Not selected: 25P unavailable, modest target share, volatile recent output.
